ticket.title: orders-api gets rejected by payments-api
ticket.description: Requests from this service to payments-api started failing at about 1:05pm UTC. No release happened.

logs.message: Cache hit ratio 0.91 for key prefix=catalog
Slow response from payment gateway latency_ms=1800
Secret payments-api-key rotated version=7 by rotation-job
Cache miss ratio 0.42 for key prefix=catalog
Request failed status=502 cause=UpstreamAuthenticationFailed for payments-api

runbooks.title: Authentication failures to an upstream
runbooks.content: Possible causes: rotated or revoked credentials, clock skew, permission changes, expired tokens. Check when the failures started and whether any secret or permission changed at that time.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: Secret payments-api-key was rotated but orders-api kept using its cached old credential, so payments-api answers 401
